common: Seamless tileable texture swatch for a stylized cel-shaded 3D game. The surface fills the entire square image edge to edge, seen perfectly flat and straight-on (orthographic), no perspective, no lighting, no shadows, no vignette, no border, no frame, no objects. Style: flat-colored anime background painting: flat base color fills, pattern drawn with thin hand-drawn warm-dark ink lines, a few sparse ink dots or short hatching strokes, muted low-saturation colors, no photographic detail, no noise, no gradients, even brightness everywhere. The pattern continues seamlessly past all four edges. No text, no letters, no logos.
